pricing.sourceRef: https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing/ (retrieved 2026-09-19) — DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash PEAK rate per 1M tokens: cache-miss input $0.30, cache-hit input $0.006, output $1.20. Peak is intentionally recorded so budget estimates do not under-report during peak hours; it over-reports off-peak usage.
